top_choice_rationale: P002 remains my leading bounded mechanism-and-test case: a minimal stochastic growth description predicts fluctuation statistics across different microscopic realizations, with experimental confirmation extending beyond visual resemblance or a fitted exponent. Kardar, Zhang and Takeuchi are a provisional theory-and-confirmation allocation; complete original authorship must sustain it, and an equally indispensable theorist cannot be sacrificed to include experiment. Dimensionality, geometry, preparation and crossover controls constrain the citation. DMFT's dynamical organizing construction and the focused QSH phase discovery are strongest alternatives. Clock shift control and original transmission correction are fundamental inventions, not inferior engineering, but I give the controlled cross-system explanation greater scientific weight here. I favor an award over P000 without treating the unresolved dossiers as closed.
recusal_note: My supplied profile establishes no direct personal or institutional tie to Kardar, Zhang or Takeuchi. Stochastic-mechanism research creates intellectual proximity, not a documented candidate conflict or automatic clearance. I disclose the closely linked Gothenburg environment shared with committee colleagues Johansson and Olsson without deferring to them. Any concrete connection uncovered in original-credit review requires independent participation assessment.
